test_objective: Check that you can create an entity

test_cases.name: 001_01_01 MinimalEntity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create an entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/json' and
 payload defined in file: 'building-minimal-without-context-sample.jsonld'
}
